description: Colgate-Palmolive Company is a caring, innovative growth company united behind its purpose to reimagine a healthier future for all people, their pets and our planet. To achieve its business and financial objectives and deliver peer-leading performance and total shareholder return it is focused on driving organic sales growth, delivering consistent compounded earnings per share growth, achieving operational efficiencies, and driving growth in free cash flow along with the efficient use of its balance sheet. It does this by leveraging the global reach and penetration of its brands, building the incremental benefit of superior, science-based innovation supported by an agile and resilient supply chain, harnessing the power of best-in-class omni-channel demand generation, leading in capabilities such as data, analytics and artificial intelligence, and evolving its high-impact, inclusive culture, and its products are marketed in over 200 countries and territories.
